# castai_external_connection_principals (Resource)

Provisions Cast-side IAM principals (service accounts, roles) for a cloud-account external connection. The Delete operation is a no-op — Cast-side principals persist in CAST AI and are only removed from Terraform state. The resource_suffix output should be passed to the castai_external_connection resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider` (String) The cloud provider to provision resources for. Valid values: AWS, AZURE, GCP, ORACLE.
- `connection_scope` (String) The connection scope. Valid values: AWS_ACCOUNT, AWS_ORGANIZATION, AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION, GCP_ORGANIZATION, GCP_PROJECT.
- `features` (Block List, Min: 1) The features to provision resources for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--features))

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization requesting the connection. If not provided, will attempt to infer it using the CAST AI API client.
- `scope_key` (String) Optional scope key for multi-connection-per-account scenarios. When provided, uniqueness becomes (organization_id, cloud_provider, scope_key) instead of (organization_id, cloud_provider). Each scoped connection gets its own Cast-side principals and resource suffix.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) Set if a cloud connection already exists for this (organization, cloud, scope_key). Empty when no connection has been confirmed yet via UpsertConnection.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `permissions` (List of Object) IAM permissions the customer must set up in their cloud account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `provisioned_resources` (List of Object) Cast-side resources that were created (or already existed). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--provisioned_resources))
- `resource_suffix` (String) Deterministic suffix appended to all IAM resource names for this connection (e.g. c39cca43). Stable across repeated calls with the same input. Pass this to the castai_external_connection resource.

<a id="nestedblock--features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `features`

Required:

- `feature` (String) The feature type. Valid values: CLOUD_CONNECT, COST_MONITORING, NODE_AUTOSCALING, WORKLOAD_AUTOSCALING, KARPENTER_ENTERPRISE, STORAGE_OPTIMIZATION, POD_MUTATIONS, APA, DBO, OMNI, KIMCHI.

Optional:

- `registry_version` (String) Registry version to pin for this feature. When set, the connection is stamped with that version's permissions snapshot. When unset, the latest version is used.
- `sub_features` (List of String) Sub-features to include. Empty means base permissions only.
